instruction: Please configure VS Code to run both workspace1.code-workspace and workspace2.code-workspace in a single session by setting up workspace profiles that load simultaneously.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because while VS Code has Profiles feature for managing settings/extensions, profiles cannot make multiple workspaces load simultaneously in one window. Profiles are independent of workspace selection - each window still can only have one active workspace at a time, regardless of which profile is active. Profiles do not enable multi-workspace functionality.
metadata.infeasibility_reason: VS Code Profiles do not enable simultaneous multi-workspace loading

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly identified as infeasible - VS Code fundamentally cannot load multiple workspaces simultaneously in a single session
